text:
Priya: Idea 1: add a console-driven, quota-aware sampling ramp for telemetry so we can safely increase samples on low-risk routes.
Dmitri: What do you mean by "quota-aware"?
Priya: Before enabling a different sample rate, the console runs a projection against recent traffic and refuses or warns if estimated sampled tokens > quota * 0.9.
Ava: Nice. Will this projection be realtime or async? Queries over 30d could be slow.
Priya: Async job that returns an estimate within the UI. Show confidence band (low/avg/high).
Dmitri: How do we handle PII risk in the newly-sampled payloads? We need an enforced redaction chain.
Priya: Runtime will apply the canonical redaction pipeline at ingress. No raw payload should be stored outside ephemeral preview retention.
Ava: Can we offer a synthetic-preview instead of capturing real examples? Legal prefers synthetic anonymized examples where possible.
Priya: Yes 1. Two preview modes: "synthetic" (generate paraphrased, de-identified examples) and "live-ephemeral" (redacted samples kept for TTL). Default to synthetic.
Dmitri: Synthetic previews are great to avoid accidental leaks. How good is paraphrase though? Might not show true failure modes.
Ava: We could show both: synthetic + a redacted live sample if tenant opts in and passes a compliance check.
Priya: Compliance check = tenant-level allowlist + admin consent + audit entry. Must be explicit.
Dmitri: Storage TTL? Ops will want very short TTL and autos-delete.
Priya: live-ephemeral TTL configurable but max 1 hour for preview entries. Backend enforces deletion and audit logs the lifecycle.
Ava: Embeddings: absolutely blocked in previews and any synthetic embedding examples must be pseudo-vectors (not real).
Priya: Agreed. No embeddings or attachment blobs in previews.
Dmitri: What about pseudonymization? We use tenant HMAC salts, right?
Priya: Yes, HMAC per-tenant stored only in KMS. Console never sees salts. We store only salted digests and display pseudonyms in UI.
Ava: On the UX: show projected cost delta next to accept button and include a "what changes" diff for retention and sample_rate.
Priya: Will do. Also include an "undo" that triggers a revert policy and an audit note.
Dmitri: For rollout, let's support staged increases: 0.1% -> 1% -> 5% over configurable windows with auto-stop if error/PII anomalies spike.
Priya: How do we detect PII anomalies automatically?
Dmitri: Runtime will emit piirisk_score per sampled item (0-1) using our deid heuristics. If aggregate score > threshold, autopause the ramp and alert.
Ava: Need dashboard metrics: ramp_progress, projected_monthly_token_cost, piirisk_rate, preview_views.
Priya: Add further control: tenant-global opt-out flag (default false) that prevents console nudges from proposing sampling changes for that tenant.
Dmitri: Good. Also require admin approval for any tenant in the "strict_compliance" class.
Ava: Legal wants an explicit checkbox in the audit entry: "I confirm live preview followed redaction rules" and the user name stored.
Legal-Bot: Noted. We'll need retention policy for those audit entries and a tamper-evidence hash.
Priya: Also suggestion: use traffic downsampling to compute preflight estimates instead of scanning full 30d dataset to reduce cost.
Dmitri: For infra: sampling policy should be a small JSON blob attached to route config. Eg:

```json
{
  "route": "POST /v1/events",
  "sampling": {
    "mode": "staged_ramp",
    "stages": ["0.001","0.01","0.05"],
    "stage_window_minutes": 60,
    "pii_protection": "standard_v3",
    "preview": {"mode":"synthetic","live_ttl_seconds":"3600"},
    "quota_guard": {"threshold_pct":90}
  },
  "meta": {"created_by":"console_nudge_v2"}
}
```

Ava: A few implementation notes: 1) quota_guard should run against the tenant's token budget, not global; 2) stage_window should be cancelable and abortable by infra if anomalies are detected.
Dmitri: We'll also expose a debug endpoint for oncall to replay a sampled batch (redacted) for triage, gated by RBAC.
Priya: Ops-bot, can you add a policy check that prevents console from starting a staged_ramp if tenant has strict_compliance true?
ops-bot: Rule added: staged-ramp-block-if-strict_compliance (FAIL on attempts).
Ava: One more: telemetry retention of sampled preview metrics should be short (30d) and segregated from long-term logs.
Priya: Sounds good. I'll sketch a tiny flow doc and mockup and drop it in the doc tracker.
Dmitri: I'll take the infra spike and start on the policy enforcement pieces.
Ava: I'll own the UI and the synthetic-preview generator prototype.
Priya: Thanks team. We'll follow up in 48h with an initial design PR. :thumbsup:
